lines.l: I was once like you are now And I know that it's not easier to be calm
When you found something going on Take your time, think a lot, think over everything
For you will still be held tomorrow, but your dreams may not
How can I try to explain, when I do, it turns away again
Now the soul will use the same old story
From the moment I could talk
I was ordered to listen
Now there's a way
And I know that I have to go away
I know I have to go
It's not the time to make a change
Just sit down and take it slow
They are still young, that's your fault
There's so much you have to go through
Find a girl, settle down
So you won't you can marry
Look at me, I am old, but I'm happy
All the times that I've cried
I keep it all things on hold
It's hard, it's hard
But it's harder to ignore it
